script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say the kings end up standing outside Jerusalem.
The comparison says trees are shaken by the wind, not that every tree leans the same way.
“The wrong house” uses “wrong” to describe the baker’s answer.
The bigger oven mitt joke does not match the action in the comparison, so it does not make sense.
The explanation repeats that the picture is not of roaring lions without adding much personality.
It gives reasons Pekah is not the proposed king that the text does not give.
The text does not say Aram and Ephraim thought they had everything figured out.
The text does not say God gives the number of years so Ahaz has something to hold onto.
Comparing Ephraim being shattered as a people to a dropped tray of cookies makes light of a serious warning.
The explanation is generic and repeats the answer without much of Papa Dorin’s voice.
The prize and trophy joke imagines the LORD handing out prizes, making Him part of the joke.
Isaiah asks two pointed questions, not one.
The passage does not mention priests, but it does not say the Lord gives the sign without help from anyone in the temple.
The text does not say anyone’s feet are safe.
The text does not mention a robe or say one stays on.
The verse does not say Assyria’s soldiers are excluded from eating curds and honey.
The verse says a thousand vines were worth a thousand shekels, not that each vine was worth that amount.
The verse says men go with bow and arrow; it does not say they do not also bring hoes or baskets.
The text does not say the hills once tilled by the hoe were vineyards.
